evidence.note: Title 'About 40% of what flats on blocks C and D spend on electricity falls in daylight hours' matches costs.md (about 40% of spend falls 08:00-18:00, audit p6), keeping the 'about' hedge.
'£612 median yearly electricity spend per flat, 2025' matches costs.md (median £612, 2025, audit p4).
48 flats, 41 households shared 2025 bills, median £612: all as in costs.md; caveat on bill sample sits in the note.

Adds 'That is the share a rooftop array can supply directly', cited to audit p6; costs.md attributes only the 40% / 08:00-18:00 split to p6, and nothing in the research says an array can supply that whole share.

rationale: The title and stat are faithful to the audit figures with hedges intact. However, reader note 2 attaches to the audit citation a claim the source does not make, stating as certain that the whole daylight share can be supplied directly by a rooftop array. That is added detail and certainty beyond the source, which meets the fail descriptor.
